plugins.name: pulse-progress
plugins.description: Cosmetic mod: a QueerPulse-coloured progress band above the prompt and a /pulse panel of subagents. It only watches; it adds no tools and changes no prompts.

plugins.name: pulse-cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during /keepwarm windows and holds a cold send once with its estimated rewrite cost. Pinging runs only after /keepwarm. Fork of karanb192/cache-tax.

plugins.name: pulse-filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree for Claude Code that shows what Claude is doing and where in files

plugins.name: pulse-reflect
plugins.description: claude-reflect as a Claude Code mod: a model check on each short prompt finds reusable corrections (any language); a band above the prompt saves them to CLAUDE.md on one press
